subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core own a new Rust launcher binary and build path for an interactive command menu, or should this stay outside core until a maintainer sponsors that product surface?
rationale: The PR adds a new user-facing product/build surface rather than repairing a defined current bug, and code review cannot decide long-term launcher ownership by itself.

options.title: Sponsor a core launcher after cleanup
options.body: Proceed only after removing local artifacts, using exact CLI delegation, wiring the build path, and proving current-head behavior.

options.title: Pause outside core for now
options.body: Do not merge this direction unless a maintainer explicitly owns the launcher packaging and release contract.

options.title: Accept the compatibility risk intentionally
options.body: Maintainers may choose to own the wrapper's extra readiness and discovery behavior, but should document and test non-default gateway setups first.

recommendation.title: Pause outside core for now
recommendation.body: Do not merge this direction unless a maintainer explicitly owns the launcher packaging and release contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The product choice overlaps the current dashboard, gateway readiness, TUI/update, and Mac gateway setup surfaces most recently carried by this history.
